Higher Education Committee
Tuesday, February 14, 2023
3:00 PM, Room G-15, Capitol

Minutes

Present: Senator Omar Fateh - Chair, Senator Aric Putnam Vice Chair, Senator Zach Duckworth, Senator Robert D. Farnsworth,
Senator Robert J. Kupec, Senator Erin P. Murphy, Senator Clare Oumou Verbeten, Senator Jason Rarick

Absent: No Members Absent

Senator Omar Fateh called the meeting to order at 3:00pm
S.F. 439: Senator Hoffman: Minnesota Higher Education Facilities Authority restructure and renaming as the Minnesota Health
and Education Facilities Authority; construction and financing of health care facilities authority authorization; bonding capacity

increase.

Senator Rarick moved that SF 439 be recommended to pass and re-referred to the State and Local Government and Veterans
Committee. Motion passed unanimously

Senator Rarick moved that S.F. 439, be recommended to pass and re-referred to the State and Local Government and Veterans
Committee.

S.F. 1288: Senator Putnam: Allied health technician scholarship program establishment.

Senator Putnam moved that S.F. 1288, be laid over.

The meeting was adjourned at 3:35pm

Weyer

Senator Omar Fateh, Chair Chris Meyer,
